description: Use when an agent needs a U.S. public company's SEC filings: latest 10-K/10-Q, 8-K events, proxies, S-1s. Input: ticker or cik, optional form (comma list, e.g. 10-K,8-K), since (YYYY-MM-DD), limit. Output: JSON company profile (CIK, name, industry, exchange, fiscal year end) and filings with dates, 8-K item codes and titles, XBRL flags, sec.gov links. Insider forms without filer names. Data: SEC EDGAR. Example: ?ticker=AAPL&form=10-K,8-K Price: $0.0027 USDC via x402.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (e.g. 320193); give ticker or cik

form.description: Only these form types, comma-separated (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13F-HR…)

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

ticker.description: U.S. ticker (AAPL, BRK.B); give ticker or cik

name: sec_filings
title: SEC EDGAR filings: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and more for any U.S.-listed company by ticker or CIK
